title: Euler Liar Round Correctness
statement: Let $N$ be a natural number with $1<N$ and $N$ odd, and let $w$ be a finite bit string. Encode $N$ by its binary expansion and pair it with $w$. The liar-round test on this encoding returns true if and only if $A=1+\operatorname{bitsVal}(w)\bmod(N-1)$ is coprime to $N$ and the Jacobi symbol of $A$ modulo $N$, regarded as an element of $\mathbb Z/N\mathbb Z$, equals $A^{(N-1)/2}$ in $\mathbb Z/N\mathbb Z$.
